notes.heading: Comparing
notes.text: The claw is designed, not converted, so this part has no reference mesh and only its revised render is shown. Its dimensions are claw_params.scad's and its features 930-001_ClawFinger.scad's header's. The same part serves every finger of both claws; the follower's is this one turned 180° about Z. Run render.rs --verify before building this page, because the render is its output.
